summary: Full E2E testing of Street Vybz game at /api/games/streets/play covering the 7 requested features (Vegas landmarks, helicopters + Air One, collision fixes, movement, cars, mobile minimap repositioning, procedural dancehall Riddim). All critical functionality verified working on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844 with ?touch). Backend leaderboard endpoints also verified.

issues: Minimap (top-center, 76x76 at top=6, left=157) slightly clips the JACKED score pill in top-left area. Screenshot shows 'JA...' truncated. Consider shifting minimap 4-6px lower or reducing HUD pill width on narrow viewports.

action_items: Minor: On mobile viewports <=420px, minimap at top=6px slightly overlaps the SCORE/JACKED HUD pills row. Consider top: 44px or reduce HUD pill sizes on narrow screens.

Optional: Player spawn is at (4.5, 4.5) which is adjacent to a building wall — after holding W for 2s, movement was only 0.6 units (smooth, no NaN, but appears to collide with a building immediately). The main agent may want to move the spawn point away from building perimeters, or verify this is intentional collision behavior. Movement math itself is correct (dt-clamped, no NaN).
critical_code_review_comments: index.html is 2178 lines in a single file — consider splitting into modules (rendering, npcs, vehicles, audio) for maintainability. Not blocking.

S.arsenal returned undefined after gun-shop tryShop() but S.cash decreased by $80 — weapons are stored under a different key than 'arsenal'. Since the KNIFE HUD pill visibly appeared (screenshot confirms), the purchase logic works, but the review_request assumed S.arsenal. Non-issue for functionality.
Riddim procedural audio exposes start/stop/setVol on window; AudioContext resumption tied to first user click (startBtn) — verified working.
seed_data_creation: Posted 1 leaderboard entry {name:'TESTBOT', score:123} to /api/games/streets/scores during backend verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Game globals confirmed available: S, npcs, helis, airOne, LM_ANIM (=10 landmarks), Riddim (start/stop/setVol), tryShop, buildings, traffic, police. Must click #startBtn first before S.running=true. For mobile use ?touch query param. Ped separation verified: 0/465 pairs closer than 0.5u across 31 alive NPCs. Helicopters: 3 ambient + 1 Air One spawns at wanted>=4. Movement: dt-clamped smooth, no NaN. Riddim uses WebAudio; setVol(0.3) works post-start.
